pages.text: The $(#D4AF37)Solar Spire$() is a powerful monument capable of cleansing the land of the Khamsin Curse. When placed, it constructs a 3-block tall tower that channels the power of Ra.

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: To activate the spire:$(br2)$(li)Place the Solar Spire block$(li)Use an $(l:ancientcurse:items/artifacts)Eye of Apophis$() on the base$(li)The spire must be near cursed earth$(br2)Once activated, it will purify a large area around it, turning cursed blocks back to their natural state.

pages.title: Warning
pages.text: $(#FF6600)Be warned:$() Defending the spire attracts enemies! The cleansing ritual takes time, and dark forces will attempt to stop you.$(br2)The spire requires a 3-block high vertical space and clear line of sight to the sky for maximum effectiveness.
